title: CAULIFLOWER FRITTERS
instructions: --Soak and boil the cauliflower in the usual way, then separate into flowers. Dip each piece into a thin batter, plunge into boiling fat and fry a delicate brown. Serve very hot on napkins. If preferred, the pieces may be dipped into a mixture of salt,  pepper,  vinegar and oil, then fried.
